generation.originalPromptSummary: Preserve the supplied two-arc Wi-Fi/lens shape and mint/teal palette; render dark teal anodized metal and frosted mint glass with realistic studio lighting.
generation.backgroundExtractionPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached user-approved Network Lens logo. Remove only the warm off-white studio background and floor. Deliver one clean isolated emblem on a truly transparent background. Preserve the approved object's appearance faithfully: entire circular frosted mint glass disc with realistic edge and shallow depth; dark teal metal magnifying glass with diagonal down-right handle, exactly two Wi-Fi arcs and one dot, the same positions, proportions, bevels, lighting, textures and optical lens reflections. Do not redesign or flatten it. Remove the floor contact shadow and any detached cast shadow; keep the self-shading within the emblem. Keep glass interior mint coloured and sufficiently opaque/readable for display over both light and dark app backgrounds. Entire object visible with a narrow even transparent safety margin, square canvas, front-facing composition, smooth clean alpha edge, no white fringe. No text, no extra symbols, no pedestal, no white or coloured square background.
